summary: China Yuchai International Ltd filed a Form 6-K containing a notice of annual general meeting (AGM) and proxy card. The meeting, scheduled for August 6, 2026, will cover routine items: adopting audited financials, approving an increase in the director fee limit, re-electing directors, re-appointing auditors, and authorizing board size. No merger, tender offer, spin-off, restructuring, or other special-situations event is described. The filing is a routine current report of a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a U.S. proxy statement for an annual meeting. There are no deal terms, pricing, or strategic actions. The only notable item is a proposed fee limit increase, but that is ordinary governance.
